title: 5 Trucks That Became Collectibles (And One That Lost $245,000)
description:
In January twenty twenty-six, a seventy-year-old Dodge work truck sold for eighty-eight thousand dollars. A Toyota pickup that people used to drive into the ground is now insured by four times as many collectors as in twenty seventeen. And in September twenty twenty-six, the very first Ford Bronco Raptor, which once sold for three hundred fifty thousand dollars, sold again for one hundred five thousand. Some trucks become collectibles. Some only pretend to.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
